t: You're at Edgware Road station on the Bakerloo line, between Paddington and Marylebone, in fare zone 1. It stands on the north-east corner of the junction of Edgware Road, Harrow Road and Marylebone Road, beside the Marylebone flyover. There is a second station with the same name nearby, south of Marylebone Road, served by the Circle, District and Hammersmith and City lines. This one was designed by Leslie Green, who is best known for his London Underground stations of the 1900s. They have oxblood red faïence blocks, pillars and semi-circular first-floor windows, with tiled interiors in the Modern Style.
